core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nawab corresponds to the Arabic form نُوَّاب (Arabic root ن و ب (n-w-b); نُوَّاب (Nuwwāb)). Its core sense is deputy, lord, master (plural of naib). Nawab is Arabic نُوَّاب (Nuwwāb) 'deputies, lords', the plural of نَائِب (nāʾib), from the root ن و ب (n-w-b). The source gloss 'Prince, Ruler' is broadly consistent. Same name as nawaab.
